text:
Maya Lopez: Customer request: EU-first private rollout with sticky sessions + shadowing. Need a simple rollout + fallback plan we can hand to infra.
Rohit Mehta: Proposal: phased steps - shadow (48h) -> sticky canary (1%/5%/20% over 72h) -> ramp. Use header X-RW-Sticky to pin sessions.
Dana Liu: Fallback ladder: 1) route to quantized variant (same API), 2) enable prefix-cache-only for hits, 3) trim max_tokens to 256 & disable streaming, 4) rollback. Each step logged and reversible.
Maya Lopez: Telemetry gates: p95 > 300ms for 10m OR 5xx > 1% for 5m OR quality proxy drop > 5% over 1h. Cost guard: token-cost >20% for 30m.
Rohit Mehta: Add a short A/B: 10% of canary traffic on quantized B to measure live quality delta. Capture embed-sim and queue 50 human reviews in first 24h.
sre-bot: sre-bot: Created runbook draft: auto-fallback toggles + manual override. Paging if fallback persists >12m.
Dana Liu: Flag schema: tenant:<name>:rollout_state with states shadow, canary, degraded, rolled_back. Audit every transition.
Maya Lopez: Owners: Product=Maya, Runtime=Rohit, Eng-ML=Dana, SRE=Vikram. Checklist: flag, telemetry dashboard, synthetic smoke 40 prompts, runbook, customer note.
engbot: engbot: Shutters API example posted to infra ticket.
Maya Lopez: OK let's lock dates in tomorrow's 15m sync. Thanks.
